_note: 80D for the assessee and family ("the spouse and dependant children", s.126(10)(b)): insurance, a notified health scheme and preventive check-ups up to ₹50000 — the senior citizen's substitution, "such person is a senior citizen, the amount of sum as provided in such clauses, shall be substituted with ₹50000 for ₹25000" (s.126(8)(a), p.162); medical expenditure up to ₹50000 (s.126(2)(c)); together "The amount of sum referred to in sub-section (2) shall not exceed ₹ 50000 in aggregate of the sum specified under sub-section (2)(a) and (c) or aggregate of the sum specified under sub-section (2)(b) and (d)" (s.126(4), p.162). Medical expenditure on a senior citizen only "if no amount has been paid to effect or to keep in force the health insurance of such person" (s.126(7)); a senior citizen is "an individual resident in India who is of the age of sixty years or more at any time during the relevant tax year" (s.2(100), p.20). The age is this row's condition, AgeAtLeast 60 of the INSURED_PERSON at any time in the year; the person's residence in India is the node's check. ChapterEightNode uses this row where any premium or scheme payment in the bucket covers a senior citizen (separate policies for a senior and a non-senior parent take the senior limit — the node's reading); a floater covering a senior and a non-senior is refused (OQ-18). Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80D, is unread (W-075d). D-136.
